CRLA No. 693 of 2023
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Rohit Kumar Gaur, Advocate, holding brief 
of Mr. B.M. Pingal, Advocate for the appellant. 
(2) Mr. J.S. Virk, Deputy Advocate General for 
the State of Uttarakhand.
(3) This is an appeal against conviction, filed under 
Section 374(2) CrPC against judgment and order 
dated 05.08.2023 passed by learned Special Sessions 
Judge (POCSO), Pithoragarh in Special Sessions Trial 
No. 43 of 2021, whereby appellant has been convicted 
under Sections 363/34, 366, 376 (2)(>) (3) IPC r/w 
Section 3/4 of Protection of Children from Sexual 
Offence Act, 2012 and sentenced to undergo seven 
years rigorous imprisonment under Section 363/34 
IPC with fine of ` 10,000/- and, in default of payment 
of fine, he was sentenced to undergo one year’s
additional rigorous imprisonment. He has also been 
convicted under Section 366 I.P.C. and directed to 
undergo ten years’ rigorous imprisonment with fine of 
` 20,000/- and, in default of payment of fine, he was 
sentenced to undergo two years’ additional rigorous
imprisonment. Appellant has further been convicted 
under Sections 376(2)(>)(3) I.P.C. and directed to 
undergo twenty years’ rigorous imprisonment with 
fine of` 50,000/- and, in default of payment of fine, he 
was sentenced to undergo five years’ additional 
rigorous imprisonment. It was directed that all the 
sentences shall run concurrently.
(4) As per office report, the appeal is within time.
(5) Heard.
(6) Admit.
(7) Summon the Lower Court Record.
(8) List on 05.01.2024.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 
 09.10.2023
Navin
